Package com.nexuslink.protocol.kafka

Class ConsumerLagCalculator

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.kafka.ConsumerLagCalculator
public final class ConsumerLagCalculator extends Object
Computes consumer-group lag from committed offsets and log-end offsets. Pure and dependency-free (no Kafka types leak in), so it is fully offline-testable: callers fetch the two offset maps from a broker and hand them here as plain (topic, partition) -> offset entries. Lag is clamped at zero — a committed offset ahead of the reported end offset (a momentary race during fetch) reads as caught-up, never negative.

  • Method Details

    • compute

      public static List<ConsumerLagCalculator.LagRow> compute(String group, Map<ConsumerLagCalculator.TopicPartitionKey,Long> committed, Map<ConsumerLagCalculator.TopicPartitionKey,Long> endOffsets)
      Builds the lag rows for group, one per committed partition that also has a known end offset. Partitions present in committed but absent from endOffsets are skipped (the end offset is needed to measure lag). Rows are sorted by topic, then by partition.

    • totalLag
